title: Development-range subclaims need explicit opt-in
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.1 Subclaims defined in this guide; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7.1 Subclaims.

statements.label: Development-range subclaims need explicit opt-in
statements.requirement: The registry SHALL classify subclaims >= 0 as WHO-reserved and negative subclaims as development range. The issuer SHALL refuse to issue a development-range subclaim unless the issuer policy explicitly allows it. The subclaim number used for a payload type SHALL be configuration, not a constant in a codec, so that DVC can move from -6 to an assigned number without an API break.

sources.quote: Do not treat a negative subclaim as a production allocation.
